data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'pharos' meaning 'far' or 'journey', Farr is a name with strong biblical roots. In the New Testament, the term 'Far Country' is used to describe the place where the lost sheep of Israel had gone. The name Farr is a reminder of the spiritual journey we all embark on in our lives. The name Farr carries the meaning “Far, Journey” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Farr usually hope their child will grow to embody far, journey and live with faith, good character and purpose.
